title: Pan-Seared Fish with Dumplings
description: A simple and flavorful dish from the Mediterranean region, featuring fish and dumplings in a delicate broth.
instructions: 2. Season the fish with salt and pepper.
3. Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
4. Sear the fish for 2-3 minutes on each side, until cooked through.
5. Transfer the fish to a baking dish and bake in the oven for 5-7 minutes.
6. Meanwhile, prepare the dumplings according to package instructions.
7. In a separate skillet, heat the fish broth over medium heat.
8. Add the garlic, lemon juice, and a pinch of salt and pepper to the broth.
9. Simmer the broth for 2-3 minutes, until heated through.
10. To serve, place the fish on a plate and top with a dumpling and a spoonful of the broth.
